title: Burning the Bridge: Agentification and Domestic Value Added
abstract: arXiv:2611.31518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Firms that replace local work with foreign AI agents can produce more per paid hour while generating less income at home. We study this trade-off in a small open economy where exporters and local services both use agents. Once wages reach a reservation floor, extending agent use in local services lowers domestic income at unchanged foreign costs. Value added at constant prices and consumption also fall if suppliers capture enough of the saving. Exporters have an offset: adopting agents can expand production and earn the foreign exchange needed to pay for them. The difference is substantial. Using Brazilian accounts as a reference, a supplier bargaining share above about 0.15 is sufficient to make further local-service adoption reduce value added even at negligible foreign costs. The corresponding threshold in tradables is about 0.66. We derive separate export-growth requirements for preserving income and consumption and illustrate them u

translated_title: 烧毁桥梁：智能体化与国内增加值
translated_abstract: 当企业用外国AI智能体取代本地工作时，每个付费小时的产出会更高，但国内产生的收入却更少。我们在一个小型开放经济体中研究这一权衡问题，其中出口商和本地服务业都使用智能体。一旦工资达到某个保留底线，在外国成本不变的情况下，扩大智能体在本地服务业中的使用会降低国内收入。如果供应商获取了足够多的成本节省，不变价增加值和消费也会下降。出口商则存在一种抵消机制：采用智能体可以扩大生产规模，并赚取支付智能体服务所需的外汇。这一差异相当显著。以巴西的国民经济账户作为参照，供应商议价份额只要超过约0.15，就足以使本地服务业进一步采用智能体导致增加值下降，即使外国成本几乎可以忽略不计也是如此。可贸易品部门相应的阈值约为0.66。我们分别推导出了维持国内收入和消费所需的出口增长条件，并进行了说明。
tldr: 该论文研究指出，用外国AI智能体替代本地服务业工作会降低国内收入和增加值，而出口部门因可扩大生产并赚取外汇而具有抵消效应；以巴西数据为例，若供应商议价份额超过约0.15（可贸易品部门约为0.66），进一步在本地服务中采用智能体将净减少国内经济价值。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that replacing local-service work with foreign AI agents reduces domestic income and value added once wages reach a reservation floor, while exporters enjoy an offsetting effect through expanded production and foreign exchange earnings, with Brazilian data indicating that supplier bargaining shares above roughly 0.15 for local services (versus 0.66 for tradables) make further agent adoption net-negative for domestic value added.
